annotations.title: Update an event or add a video meeting

description: Live calendars: works on the real calendars people connected to the app. Changes an existing event in place: its title, times, location, description, attendees, or video meeting. Attendees get an update, not a new invitation. To add a video link to an event, pass meeting: meet on a Google calendar, teams on an Outlook calendar, or zoom on any calendar with zoomAccountId, a connected Zoom account from list_accounts. If the person has more than one Zoom account and hasn't said which, ask them which. Pyas calendars (the sandbox's people) take zoom only. An event that already has a meeting gets a new link, and meeting none removes it. Only the fields you pass change. To change the time, pass both startsAt and endsAt, keeping the event's length unless the person changed it. To reject the update if someone else changed the event first, pass the version from get_event.

accountId.description: A Pyas account ID (list_accounts returns them).

attendees.description: The full list, which replaces the current one.

endsAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

meeting.description: Add a video meeting: meet (Google calendars), teams (Outlook calendars) or zoom (with zoomAccountId). none removes the event's meeting.

startsAt.description: An ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-10-21T15:00:00Z (or with an offset).

zoomAccountId.description: For zoom: the connected Zoom account to make the meeting with (provider zoom in list_accounts).
